TRUST & SAFETY

VIP AI Security Guard

Globe Talk Pro की safety, reports और admin review का एक ही control center. वास्तविक निगरानी और कार्रवाई के लिए सुरक्षित server-side moderation service आवश्यक है.

VIP AI Security Guard – Full App Safety & Moderation System

Public/private chat, rooms, video/content, accounts, wallet events और child-safety signals के लिए policy-based checks.

Backend setup required
Monitoring scope
Public chat and room messages; reported private-chat content with disclosure and limited review; user reports; room/account/wallet abuse signals. No continuous secret audio/video recording.
Moderation sequence
Risk detection → warning → temporary feature restriction → room removal or room closure when necessary → human admin review. No automatic permanent ban.
Evidence and privacy
Keep only necessary report evidence for a defined retention period; restrict access by admin role; encrypt data in transit and at rest; support deletion and audit trails.
Current status: this page is the frontend control panel and implementation guideline. It does not yet monitor live chats, calls, video, or users. Do not describe the guard as active until the trusted backend, moderation model, rules, and admin review flow are deployed and tested.

Community safety

Members can report content or users and manage their block list.

Admin review queue

Not connected — secure moderation API and role-based admin login are required.

Report triage
Severity, duplicate reports, context and evidence review
Human decision
Dismiss, warn, temporarily restrict, remove from room, or close room

Privacy & child safety

Age-appropriate defaults, report/block access, limited private-message review, no secret recording, and clear privacy notices.

महत्वपूर्ण: यहाँ GitHub personal access token, Agora App Certificate, Firebase service-account JSON या AI secret key न डालें। GitHub OAuth से अनुमति लें; निजी keys server-side Secret Manager में रहेंगी। GitHub Actions secrets को GitHub API से पढ़कर निकालना संभव/उचित नहीं है—backend में जरूरी secrets अलग से सुरक्षित रूप से configure करने होंगे।
